name: KRUSTY graphical benchmark
description: Numerical supplement to the manuscript “When Does a Two-Node Thermal Model Suffice? An Evidence-Graded Reduced-Order Benchmark for the KRUSTY Heat-Pipe Microreactor Test”. Contents: source-tagged digitization of power and outer-fuel-temperature series from the published KRUSTY panels (source Figures P5, P6, P15, P18 and P19 of Poston et al., Nucl. Technol. 2020, doi:10.1080/00295450.2020.1730673); frozen model parameter vectors; scoring masks; sensitivity, refit and cross-panel diagnostics; the regeneration scripts (recompute_all_outputs.py, recompute_review_extensions.py, recompute_round3_extensions.py, verify_release.py); and independently generated publication figures. The archive contains only digitized numerical values and author-generated outputs. It contains no original publisher artwork, crops or traced images. Code is released under the MIT license and author-generated data/tables under CC BY 4.0; these licenses grant no rights in the underlying third-party figures or articles. Manuscript tables 3, 8, 9 and 16 are regenerated by recompute_round3_extensions.py; all other tables by the second-round scripts. Archived scores agree with the manuscript to the reported precision.
